name: reeo
description: REEO — digital logic, limitless curiosity. The original circuit playground, renewed.
author: REEO contributors; original BOOLR by Gees Brouwer

scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun --bun vite build
scripts.lint: bun run lint:oxlint && bun run lint:biome
scripts.lint:biome: biome lint src electron tests scripts *.ts
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run docs:verify && bun run test
scripts.desktop:compile: bun build electron/main.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external=electron --outfile=electron-out/main.cjs && bun build electron/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external=electron --outfile=electron-out/preload.cjs
scripts.desktop:dev: bun run build && bun run desktop:compile && electron .
scripts.desktop:pack: bun run build && bun run desktop:compile && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.mobile:android: bun run build && cap sync android && bun run mobile:assets
scripts.mobile:ios: bun run build && cap sync ios && bun run mobile:assets
scripts.build:vercel: bun run build:web && bun run verify:web
